name: STABILA Statīvs lāzeriekārtām BST-S
desc: Aluminium construction tripod for use outdoors. Tripod legs have spikes to ensure good stability. Rapid locking mechanism for aligning the tripod quickly, even on uneven ground. Spread stopper with high-quality chain. Carry pouch for easy transport. Height-adjustable: 100 cm to 160 cm. 5/8“ threaded screw.
